facts: A04 card repository semantics are already executable and storage independent.
Legacy web and Android both carry checklist/item positions and deletion semantics but their observed local position allocation gaps differ.
A07/A07b UTS was reported green before A08.
inferences: A payload-free durable pending marker can make local mutation durability explicit without pretending A10 sync convergence exists.
proposals: Schema v3 adds checklist/item durability, tombstones, local mutation sequence state and pending markers behind the existing repository boundary.
LOCAL_APPEND_STEP remains application-local policy and is not a domain or protocol compatibility constant.
unresolved: A10 owns remote convergence, field/version merge, outbox payload and replay behavior.
A09 owns production durable secret providers.
Cross-client position rebalance/allocation compatibility is intentionally not frozen by A08.
